# origincloud_network_acl (Resource)

Stateless rules for the traffic in and out of the subnets associated with the ACL.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project the acl is in. Changing it replaces the acl.
- `region` (String) The region the acl is in. Changing it replaces the acl.
- `vpc` (String) The VPC the ACL belongs to, in the same project and region. Changing it replaces the acl.

### Optional

- `tags` (Map of String) Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the ACL was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) The principal that created the ACL, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`; empty for one the platform created.
- `id` (String) The acl's resource name, the same as `name`.
- `name` (String) The ACL's resource name.
- `urn` (String) The ACL's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use.
- `vpc_default` (Boolean) Whether the platform created the ACL with the VPC. Only the project's default VPC has such resources. It can't be deleted, and goes with its VPC.
